top_signals.title: Trump Won’t Rule Out ‘Mother of All Bombs’ on Iran, Taiwan Tightens Chip Curbs
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Ludovic Subran, Allianz Chief Investment Officer & Chief Economist; Elisabeth Braw, The Atlantic Council Senior Fellow; Dambisa Moyo, Versaca Investments Principal; Gustavo Pimenta​, Vale CEO  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: BofA’s Hartnett Sees Investors Avoiding Risk on Fed, Midterms
top_signals.summary: Risk aversion is set to dominate markets in coming weeks as investors seek shelter from higher interest rates and volatility around US midterm elections and the AI trade, according to Bank of America Corp.’s Michael Hartnett.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Apple and Meta team up to make Muse AI model run on Mac computers
top_signals.summary: Apple and Meta are collaborating to make Muse Spark Open easier to run locally on clustered Mac Studio systems, according to the companies.
